zh_CN:
界面导航
Tab／Shift+Tab：移动焦点；Enter／空格：启用当前按钮。
%s：打开或关闭本页。
%s：打开或关闭观察手册。
%s：切换普通观察与模块布局。
Esc：关闭当前面板；没有面板时打开暂停菜单。

观察操作
画面中的按钮只改变环境、设施或可用资源，不直接命令单只蚂蚁。1×、4×、16×只改变现实时间内处理的固定观察步数量。帮助、手册和暂停菜单打开时，模拟与视觉插值都会停止。

模块布局（固定键）
P：开始放置当前设施；方向键：移动预览；Enter：确认；R：旋转；Tab：按稳定 ID 选择下一项设施；Delete／Backspace：拆除；WASD：平移；+／−：缩放；0：重置视图。
有效预览同时显示绿色、勾号与“可以放置”；无效预览同时显示红色、叉号与原因提示。闸门的开放／关闭也使用不同线条符号，不只依靠颜色。

显示设置
标题页的“设置”可调整 100%%／125%%／150%% 界面缩放、减少动效、窗口模式、语言和主音量；“键盘与快捷键”可修改本页、观察手册和模块布局入口。
en:
Interface navigation
Tab / Shift+Tab: move focus; Enter / Space: activate the focused button.
%s: open or close this page.
%s: open or close the observation journal.
%s: switch between habitat observation and module layout.
Esc: close the current panel; when none is open, open the pause menu.

Observation controls
On-screen controls change environment, facilities, or available resources; they never order an individual ant. 1×, 4×, and 16× only change how many fixed observation steps run per real-time interval. Simulation and visual interpolation stop while Help, Journal, or Pause is open.

Module layout (fixed keys)
P: place the selected facility; Arrow keys: move preview; Enter: confirm; R: rotate; Tab: select the next facility by stable ID; Delete / Backspace: remove; WASD: pan; + / −: zoom; 0: reset view.
A valid preview uses green, a check mark, and “Can place.” An invalid preview uses red, a cross, and a reason message. Gate open/closed states also use distinct line symbols, not color alone.

Display settings
From the title page, Settings controls 100%% / 125%% / 150%% UI scale, reduced motion, window mode, language, and master volume. Keyboard & shortcuts remaps Help, Journal, and Module Layout.
